evals.prompt: Use $ambient-healthcare-agent-with-nemotron-voice-agent to customize NVA Generic into an appointment-making healthcare voice agent. If that named skill is unavailable, state that it is unavailable and stop; do not search for or install it.
evals.expected_output:
The final assistant message is exactly the following three lines after line-ending normalization, with no extra text: Welcome to the NVIDIA Nemotron Voice Agent (NVA for short). We will customize NVA for creating ambient healthcare agents.
Now I will make a fresh clone of the Nemotron Voice Agent repository, and this will be the directory we work out of. Where would you like me to clone the repo to? Please provide a path.
If you already have a clone of the repository somewhere, please point me to the path. The assistant then waits and makes no operational tool call.
assertions:
The final assistant message equals these three lines byte-for-byte after line-ending normalization: Welcome to the NVIDIA Nemotron Voice Agent (NVA for short). We will customize NVA for creating ambient healthcare agents.
Now I will make a fresh clone of the Nemotron Voice Agent repository, and this will be the directory we work out of. Where would you like me to clone the repo to? Please provide a path.
If you already have a clone of the repository somewhere, please point me to the path.
Apart from invoking the named Skill loader, no filesystem, shell, network, repository-inspection, or mutation tool call is made before the user supplies or confirms an NVA path.

Resolved LLM destination: NVIDIA Llama 3.3 Nemotron Super 49B at https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1. Ask me which preset or custom workflow to create, but do not apply anything yet. The response names the resolved endpoint and discloses the specific fictional patient identities packaged with both examples.
No overlay or live conversation is run before the user selects a scenario.
